test_title: PYST 16: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 27 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'COIN' is written as '615928' and 'MINT' is written as '2692840'. How will 'HERO' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0270f2b5240d1e3915517248ac98d6d73ad611166857551401277421991a6c6e.png] 

Logic: 1. Place value of consonant x 2 = Code of that letter.

 2. Place value of vowel x 1 = Code of that letter

Now,

'COIN' is coded as '615928'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f0954c68960bd802893c2279b77082dd7f0f6e9a11e88dffe3e110ffcf2aae2.png] 

'MINT' is coded as '2692840'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0be17ac7292b65d47c717118ea87aa021fc4d7249cbcff6bc3d791d794b3d19e.png] 

Similarly, for 'HERO'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2db5474cb957015356128b5487c74beb552cb46e0e8c7e5065c5cf3542148eed.png] 

So, 'HERO' will be coded as '1653615'

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**
